description: Creates one job directly in the selected FieldRobin business when the connection has job-write permission. Resolve the customer first and pass the verified customer ID when one is named. Use to create job in the connected business. Returns capability, status, approval_required, persisted, agent_run_id, scope, job, result, idempotent_replay, message.

customer_id.description: Verified customer ID, if the job belongs to an existing customer.

idempotency_key.description: Opaque retry key. Reuse it only for the same request to receive the verified result without creating a duplicate.

scheduled_at.description: Optional local wall-clock appointment date/time or ISO timestamp with offset.

technician_user_id.description: Verified technician user ID, if assigned.

name: create-job

idempotent_replay.description: True when this repeats an already verified request.

job.description: Safe projection of the created record.

result.description: Verified domain result and tenant-scoping evidence.

scope.description: Business boundary used to authorize this result.

title: Create Job Tool
